verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt index at docs.helicone.ai/llms.txt. Individual doc pages are served as markdown and point agents back to that index, and many docs are cited at .md URLs. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec (swagger.json) is also published, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated full-content dump, and no independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
